_about: Checks that fail today and that Mark has been told about. A check listed here does not block a release, but every run prints it. There is no flag to ignore a failure: the only way to release past one is to list it here, with the reason and who accepted it, in a commit Mark can see. Remove an entry the moment its check passes.
